rules.text: Clearance merchandise marked down 65% or more, merchandise on sale with an additional discount, and personalized merchandise are non-returnable and non-exchangeable.
rules.quote: The following items are non-returnable and non-exchangeable: (1) clearance merchandise marked down 65% or more; (2) merchandise on sale with an additional discount, e.g. items marked down 25% plus an additional 30-50% discount for a limited time; and (3) personalized merchandise.

rules.text: In-store returns must be made within 30 calendar days of purchase unless otherwise noted on the receipt or at point of sale.
rules.quote: no more than 30 calendar days have passed from the date of purchase (unless the face of the receipt or a notice at point of sale indicates that a longer return period is available)

rules.text: Using Dillard's return label for mail returns costs $9.95, deducted from the refund.
rules.quote: The restocking fee, plus any applicable taxes, will be deducted from your refunded amount. The restocking fee will be in addition to the $9.95 charged for use of a Dillard's return label.

rules.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method or as Dillard's merchandise credit, customer's choice.
rules.quote: Dillard’s will issue a refund in the form and amount of the original tender paid (including sales tax) or a Dillard’s merchandise credit, at the customer’s choice.

rules.text: Refunds for check purchases have a 10-day waiting period before cash or check refund is issued.
rules.quote: Refunds for check purchases will have a ten (10) day waiting period before a cash or check refund is issued.

rules.text: Returns of merchandise purchased using Afterpay will be refunded via Dillard's gift card or credited back to Afterpay account.
rules.quote: Note – merchandise purchased using Afterpay and returned will be issued a Dillard's gift card or credited back to your Afterpay account for the purchase price.

rules.text: Dillard's does not issue price adjustments.
rules.quote: Dillard's does not issue Price Adjustments.
